notes: Deploys src/Conditionals.sol:Conditionals on Robinhood Chain using the supplied IMD, IdentityMD Intake v2 and oracle signer addresses. Ownership is assigned to $owner. The constructor sets a 0.5 IMD question price, panel size 5 and quorum 4. On settlement, the winning side in the realized world shares its pot after 2% is sent to the fixed burn address and 1% to the supplied fee recipient; the other world and one-sided worlds are refunded. Unresolved markets can be voided after the 30 day resolution period, subject to the pending-ask retry delay. The owner can change the fee recipient and rotate oracle configuration for future markets after a 3 day delay.
